answer: Give each account a knoll of its own: a small public observation post where three strangers who have never interacted before must stand together and confirm the account's activity, so a lone operator cannot vouch for its own clones. Arrange participation on a terrace of tiers: each tier demands a different kind of real work — discussion, review, mentorship — and weight only grows by climbing one terrace at a time, never by repeating the same task. Finally, let idle weight decay toward a nadir floor, so farmed accounts that stop proving themselves sink back to nothing.
